stem.en: What is the aim of delimitation?

text.en: To give every constituency more people, so that each MP has more voters.
To let each State redraw its boundaries whenever its government wishes.
To keep seats and population in as close to an equal ratio as possible.
To fix boundaries once, so that every voter always votes in the same place.

explanation.en: Delimitation aims to keep the ratio of seats to population as close to equal as possible across all constituencies.

hints.en: The aim is about a ratio.
